annotations.title: One building and its units: form, unit mix, EPC mix, HMO count

description:
One building and its units: storeys, height, footprint, use, unit mix (residential and
    commercial counts), EPC mix and HMO count, as named groups, then a page of its units
    (address text, type, bedrooms, floor area, EPC rating, HMO flag, identity). Give exactly ONE
    of `building_id` (a UUID) or `uprn`. Use it for "what is this building" and "what is in it".

    Do NOT use it to value, estimate or appraise the building. It carries no owner or person
    data: use `ownership` for who owns it, and `area_profile` for area totals. Free text is
    refused (call resolve_place first). A UPRN with more than 20 adverts is a block, not one
    home: read `identity` on each unit. A group the property service does not hold is
    covered=false with the reason, never guessed.

    Cost: 15 credits (the /buildings/physical price) for the building record, charged only when it
    is returned, on the first page; following `next_cursor` for more units is free. covered=false
    or an upstream failure is not charged.

    Limits: 25 units per page, at most 50 (`limit`); more pages via `next_cursor`; result cut to
    8 KB; UK only.

    Free. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
